necessary_context.content: Minimize convex differentiable f:X→R over a nonempty compact convex X⊆R^n. The gradient obeys ||f'(x)-f'(y)||_*≤L||x-y|| for all x,y∈X. The norm is induced by the inner product used in the quadratic subproblem. f*=min_X f.
necessary_context.name: Problem and smoothness

necessary_context.content: D_X=max_{x,y∈X}||x-y||. Exact gradient queries are made at outer points; exact linear optimization over X is used in each CndG gap test. The same outer gradient is reused throughout a CndG call.
necessary_context.name: Diameter and oracle resources

necessary_context.content: Lemma 1 gives weighted recurrence summation. Theorem 2(a) bounds outer error under γ_1=1, Lγ_k≤β_k and nondecreasing β_kγ_k/Γ_k. Theorem 2(c) supplies the source's inner-iteration estimate. These are internal passages of this Source, not separately published memory dependencies.
